retained_harness_limits: First harness constrained only a parent of a fixed-position frame and therefore did not prove allocated width. That run was superseded by measured actual-frame allocation.

Initial diff serialization failed because the upstream file lacks a final newline; git-generated patches with explicit upstream SHA-256 and result hash verification replaced that failed packaging attempt.
native_action_guard: All native calls except layout publication and state reads are test failures; all attempted playback writes are intercepted, rejected and counted.

consumer_reuse_guards.operations: read-only served-asset/source checks; isolated browser contexts; one mocked chat reply

failed_checks: actual Aries-served shell assets match selected build bytes
